svg.title: The built-in palette
svg.desc: The built-in palette in 8-bit color, in three groups: the 16 ANSI colors in two rows of 8, the 6x6x6 color cube as six blocks of 6 by 6 with red by block, green by row, and blue by column, and the grays from dark to light, from color 16, the black of the cube, through colors 232 to 255, to color 231, the white of the cube. Color 0 is black and transparent.
svg.text: 0-15: ANSI colors, 0 is transparent black, 16 is opaque black
16-231: 6x6x6 color cube, ANSI_CUBE(r, g, b), red by block, green by row, blue by column
